prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" lawyer, as the right choice depends on your specific injuries, whether the case settles or goes to trial, and the complexity of the commercial trucking company involved. Several highly rated law firms and trial lawyers in Dallas have strong track records handling 18-wheeler and commercial truck accidents:
Mullen & Mullen Law Firm4.9(516)Personal injury attorneyClosed1825 Market Center Blvd #200CallDirectionsWebsiteLed by managing attorney Shane V. Mullen (top-rated by Thomson Reuters and a multi-million dollar advocates forum member), the firm has decades of experience handling severe personal injury and commercial truck cases on a contingency fee basis ($0 upfront fees).Zehl & Associates5.0(1.4K)Personal injury attorneyOpenHouston, TXCallDirectionsWebsiteKnown for undefeated commercial vehicle and 18-wheeler verdicts in Texas, including record-breaking multi-million dollar results and a $37.5 million Dallas County verdict.NMW Law FirmPersonal injury attorneyOpenPlano, TXCallDirectionsWebsiteLed by Nick Wills, this firm takes a medical-first approach backed by strong physician referrals and over $200 million recovered for injured Texans.Witherite Law Group4.6(1.9K)Personal injury attorneyOpen10440 N Central Expy #400CallDirectionsWebsiteWitherite Law Group (widely known as 1-800-TRUCK-WRECK): Specializes heavily in rapid-response truck and 18-wheeler accident investigations, evidence preservation, and commercial fleet litigation.Winocour Law4.6(342)Personal injury attorneyOpen1511 E Levee St suite bCallDirectionsWebsiteFeatures board-certified trial lawyer Mike C. Miller, who brings over four decades of experience fighting industrial and trucking giants. Mullen & Mullen Law Firm +6
Rapid Evidence Collection: Commercial trucking companies and insurers often dispatch teams to the crash site immediately. A good firm uses a rapid-response team to preserve electronic "black box" data, driver logs (Hours-of-Service), maintenance records, and video footage before it gets deleted (often within 72 hours). Rad Law Firm
Contingency Fee Structure: Most reputable truck accident attorneys in Texas work on a contingency fee (typically around 33% before trial or 40% if the case goes to litigation), meaning you pay no out-of-pocket or upfront costs—they only get paid if they recover money for you. Texas Bulldog +1
Experience with FMCSA Regulations: Unlike standard car wrecks, commercial truck cases involve federal motor carrier safety rules, multiple potentially liable parties (the driver, the trucking company, cargo loaders, and maintenance contractors), and higher insurance policy limits. Haque Law, PLLC +1
How severe are the injuries or medical bills?
Did the accident happen recently (Texas has a 2-year statute of limitations)?
Are you looking for a local boutique firm or a large statewide trial practice?
